items.title: Last Straws: John Chaffe, Bris Jones, Bill Lee, Frank De La Houssaye, Bob Ice Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: I studied with him for a few months in the summer of 48

ctx.x: You read music then? Right. Did you have any teacher other than Bill?
Irving Fazol. I studied with him for a few months in the summer of 48, not long before he died. Probably one of Faz's few students that he ever had, actually, you know, as far as studio stuff.
Mm-hmm. When did you start playing with bands?
